aboutSources: Official names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles and re-checked 19 Nov 2026. Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, from the official description. Where the description does not pin down an exact place or trigger, the guide says so instead of inventing one. Counts (count + count_label) are the exact totals PlayStation tracks, as PSNProfiles shows them on 19 Nov 2026.
list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to chase. Work through this guide in roadmap order: finish the story first (stages 1 and 2), clear the missable contact and stranger strands before the finale (stage 3), then sweep collectibles and activities (stages 4 and 5), and save the long grinds for last (stage 6). If one trophy is holding you back, the roadmap view shows exactly which stage it belongs to and the trophy's own page names its sources, checked 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Follow the roadmap stages 1 to 6 in this guide.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one lands.

trophies.guide: This is the first story trophy most players will earn, for finishing the opening mission Gone Fishing. Play through the mission as directed; it teaches the basic movement, driving and fishing controls, so take it slow and learn the prompts instead of rushing. If you fail a section, the mission restarts from its last checkpoint and the trophy still unlocks on completion.

Follow the on-screen prompts through the fishing sequence.
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing every mission in Chapter 1. Chapters complete in story order, so simply keep playing the main missions marked on the map and the trophy will come on its own. Story trophies cannot be missed: missions can be replayed from the pause menu, and progress is saved per mission.

Finish the last mission of Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing every mission in Chapter 2. Keep following the main story thread and clear the missions as they appear; side activities are optional at this point and nothing in the chapter locks you out of the trophy. If a mission gives you trouble, lower the difficulty in the settings or replay it from a checkpoint.

Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing every mission in Chapter 3, the chapter that opens up Vice City proper. By now the map is much wider, so use fast travel and the mission markers to keep moving; there is no need to clear side content first. The trophy unlocks at the end of the chapter's final mission, just like the chapters before it.

PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)

Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter's end.

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so before you push through it, finish the contact finales and stranger strands flagged as missable in this guide — several characters' final missions are best done while the story is still open. Then play the chapter through to its end.

PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)

Play the main story missions through Chapter 4.
Finish the chapter's final mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: The gold story trophy, awarded for completing the final mission of the game. Make a manual save before you start it: the finale is the natural point of no return for the partner and contact trophies, so a save here lets you go back and clean them up. Stock up on ammo and armour, play the mission through, and the gold is yours at the credits.

PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks naturally as you play the main story, so there is nothing special to prepare. If you fail during the mission, retry from the checkpoint; the trophy only cares that the mission is completed, not how cleanly.

sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)

Play it through to the end.

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission The Cartel Heist, one of the big set-piece heists. Heist missions usually have a planning or setup beat first, so follow the mission markers and complete any setup steps the game asks for. The trophy unlocks when the heist itself is finished and the crew gets away.

sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)

Play The Cartel Heist through to the escape.

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies, it comes from simply finishing the mission, so play it at your own pace and use checkpoints if a section goes wrong. Nothing in this mission needs to be done in a special order or within a time limit.

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission Headliners. Missions with a named trophy are story beats the game will lead you to, so keep an eye on the map for the mission marker and play it when it appears. Complete the mission and the trophy is yours; replaying is available from the pause menu if anything goes wrong.

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission VCIA Takedown. The name suggests an airport job, so expect a loud, combat-heavy mission: bring full armour, a good rifle and plenty of ammo before you start. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks; checkpoints cover you if a firefight goes badly.

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The operation name points to a military-style set piece, so expect heavy resistance and possibly vehicle sections. Take it in stages, use cover, and let the checkpoints carry you through the hardest parts; the trophy unlocks when the operation ends.

sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)

Play Operation Savage Glory through to the end.
The trophy unlocks on mission completion.

trophies.guide: The gold completion trophy, awarded for reaching 100% on the in-game completion checklist — PlayStation tracks the count as 0 to 100, verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026. This is the long one: it counts story missions, side strands, collectibles, activities and the grinds in this guide, so treat it as the finish line of the whole list rather than a trophy to chase early. Open the stats or completion screen in the pause menu to see exactly which categories are still short, then work through them one at a time.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Finish the story and all side strands first.
Check the in-game completion screen for missing categories.
Clear every category until the counter reads 100%.

trophies.guide: PSN tracks a count of 250 stunts, verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026, so this is a pure volume grind best done in small sessions rather than one sitting. A stunt is any jump, near-miss, airtime or drift the game flashes as a stunt, so the fastest way is a fast bike or sports car on open roads: jump ramps, thread traffic for near-misses, and chain drifts on long bends. Stunts count in free roam as well as missions, so build them up naturally while travelling between objectives.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Use a fast bike or sports car in free roam.
Chain jumps, near-misses and drifts for stunt credit.
Check your PSN count as you go; stop at 250.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Awarded for sampling every activity type the game offers — nine of them, by the count PSN tracks (verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). This is a taster trophy: visit one of each activity (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation spots, drone races, hunting and the other side activities) and try it once. You do not need to win or finish anything, just start each type, so it is an easy early trophy if you tick them off as you find them.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Find one activity of each of the 9 types.
Start each one once — no win needed.
The trophy unlocks when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The silver skill trophy: gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). Each challenge scores accuracy, speed or both, so learn the range's scoring first on the easy lanes, then work through the list. Use a steady aim, fire in short bursts rather than spraying, and replay any challenge you silver or bronze until it turns gold. The range is repeatable with no cost per try beyond your time.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open the challenge list.
Work through all 42 challenges, aiming for gold each time.
Replay any non-gold challenge until all 42 are gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its 14 locations around Leonida (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). Drone races are time trials through rings, so the trick is learning each course's line: fly the first attempt slowly to memorise the ring order, then run it fast. Crashing costs time, not the race, so prioritise clean lines over top speed until you know the course, then push for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race markers on the map.
Learn each course's ring order on a slow first run.
Win the race at all 14 locations.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). Races are scattered across Leonida in several disciplines, so keep a list of the ones you have won and move on to new events instead of replaying favourites. Pick a well-handling car for road races and a fast bike where the event allows it, and use the racing line the game shows to carry speed through corners.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)

Win each event once and move to a new one.
Stop when 20 different races are won.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: you and Cal fish the same spot and the bigger catch wins, so the basics matter more than luck. Cast where the water ripples, wait for the bite, then reel steadily without letting the line snap — short, controlled pulls beat frantic reeling. If you lose, challenge him again; the trophy only needs one win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Find Cal and take the fishing challenge.
Reel steadily and keep the line from snapping.
Beat his catch once to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Arcade games are short, self-contained minigames — pick whichever cabinet you like, learn its controls from the on-screen prompts, and play it through to its end screen. You do not need a high score, just a completed run, so choose the simplest-looking game first.

sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)

Pick any game and play it through.
Finish the game to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Andy's last mission. Contact strands like Andy's are a chain of missions that unlock one after another, so keep returning to his marker whenever it appears and play each job in order. This one is flagged missable in this guide: contact finales are best finished before the final story mission, while the character is still available, so do not leave Andy's chain until after the credits.
trophies.missable_reason: Andy's chain closes with the story: finish his final mission before the finale, while he is still giving out work.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: The silver stranger trophy: complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). Strangers appear as question-mark markers on the map, and each one is a short chain of missions rather than a single job. They are scattered across the whole state, so explore beyond Vice City — the countryside and small towns hold several. Finish all the missions in a strand before it counts, and keep a tally until you reach 8.

Finish 8 full strands to unlock the silver.

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Randy's last mission. Randy's strand is a chain of jobs that opens as the story moves on, so take his missions whenever the marker shows and work through them in order. Flagged missable in this guide: contact finales are best wrapped up before the final story mission, while the character is still around to hand out work.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). Meditation spots are quiet, scenic places — hilltops, beaches, piers and lookouts — marked when you get close, so this is an exploration trophy as much as a checklist one. Visit each spot and use the meditate prompt; the counter ticks up per spot, and there is no time pressure, so fold it into your map sweep for the exploration trophy.

sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)

Use the meditate prompt at each spot you find.
Meditate at all 18 spots to unlock the trophy.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a tracking job: follow the clues he gives you to the animal's territory, then track it quietly — move slowly, stay downwind, and use a scoped rifle so you can take the shot from range. Unique animals do not respawn on a short timer, so if the shot misses, back off and re-approach rather than chasing it through the brush.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Take Bret's hunt and follow his clues to the territory.
Track the animal quietly and stay downwind.
Take the shot with a scoped rifle to finish the hunt.

trophies.guide: The silver card trophy: complete 3 full collectible card sets (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, houses, vehicles and out-of-the-way spots — and each set needs every card in it, so this is a proper hunt. Pick up cards whenever you spot their glint while exploring, and use the in-game collection screen to see which sets are closest to complete, then focus on those three first.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Pick up cards whenever you spot them while exploring.
Check the collection screen to see which sets are nearest complete.
Complete any 3 full sets to unlock the silver.

trophies.guide: The silver WAiNK trophy: use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). WAiNK is the in-game photo-sharing app, so the loop is simple — go somewhere new, open WAiNK, and post from that spot. The counter only moves for new locations, so keep moving: city landmarks, beaches, countryside, interiors. Fold it into your exploration sweep and it will climb steadily without a dedicated grind.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Travel to a new location and open WAiNK.
Post from that spot to count it.
Repeat at 100 different locations.

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). Challenges are the small goals the game tracks across everything you do — driving, combat, exploration, activities — and they complete passively as you play, so this trophy mostly takes care of itself. Open the challenges screen in the pause menu to see which ones are close, then nudge the nearest ones over the line: a few near-misses here, a few headshots there, and the counter climbs.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Open the challenges screen to see which are close.
Play normally and let challenges complete passively.
Push the nearest ones over the line until you reach 50.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. First, make sure your partner is actually in the car or on foot beside you — the trophy needs them present. Then build heat fast: commit crimes in a busy area until the wanted level hits 4 stars, then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and hide until the stars fade. Flagged missable in this guide: it needs your partner beside you, so do it during the story while partner missions are still available, not after the finale.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner beside you: do it during the story, while partner missions are still available.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Start with your partner beside you.
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars in a busy area.
Break line of sight and escape until the stars fade.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level alive the whole time. The trick is speed and route: pick three shops close together, rob the first, get out fast, and drive straight to the next before the heat dies down. Keep your partner with you, do not let the wanted level drop to zero between robberies, and do not get busted or wasted. Flagged missable in this guide: it needs your partner, so do it while partner missions are still available.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner beside you: do it during the story, while partner missions are still available.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Pick three shops close together, with your partner beside you.
Rob the first and drive straight to the next.
Rob all three without the wanted level dropping to zero.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). Every new vehicle you get into or drive for the first time counts, so variety is the whole game: steal or borrow a different car, bike, boat or truck whenever you see one you have not driven. Check the vehicle collection screen to see what you have found and what is still missing, and sweep car parks, docks and back roads for the rarer ones.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Drive a different vehicle whenever you see a new one.
Check the collection screen for what is still missing.
Keep going until 100 vehicles are discovered.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode, so the setup matters: find a group of at least five enemies, get into cover with a clear line on all of them, and trigger Combat Focus only when they are bunched together. An automatic weapon helps — sweep across the group and let the slowed time do the work. If the meter runs out early, retry at a busy shootout.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Find a group of five or more enemies bunched together.
Trigger Combat Focus from cover with an automatic weapon.
Take down all 5 before the meter runs out.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — in other words, leave the airport by air without buying a ticket. Steal a plane or helicopter from the airfield and take off. The airport is guarded, so expect a wanted level the moment you cross the fence: go in fast, grab an aircraft, and climb steeply once you are airborne.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Get into VCIA and reach the airfield.
Steal a plane or helicopter.
Take off for an unscheduled departure.

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about the Rhino tank, and the trophy is tied to the tank itself: get into a Rhino and use it. Military hardware is heavily guarded, so expect a fight to reach one — the usual route is a military base or a wanted-level escalation that brings tanks out. Once you are in the driver's seat, the trophy should pop; if it does not, fire the cannon and drive it a short distance.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Scout a military base or push your wanted level until a Rhino appears.
Get into the driver's seat.
Drive and fire the cannon until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get out without ever being detected. Stealth is everything here: scout the store first, learn the guard and camera positions, and move only when no one is looking. A suppressed weapon helps if a guard has to be dealt with quietly, and the getaway matters as much as the robbery — leave before the alarm goes up and do not trip a single sensor.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Scout the store's guards and cameras first.
Move only when no one is looking; stay quiet.
Get out with the goods before any alarm.

trophies.guide: The silver vault trophy: rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). Bank vaults are the big robberies — they need planning, a good crew of weapons and armour, and a clean getaway route. Hit one vault, escape the wanted level completely, and move on to the next; the counter only climbs on a successful escape, so a busted robbery does not count. Space them out across your playthrough rather than forcing all five in one session.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Plan the robbery and stock up on armour and ammo.
Rob the vault, then escape the wanted level fully.
Repeat at 5 different vaults.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the city, so find one on the road, block it or force it to stop, and crack it open — explosives or heavy weapons work where fists will not. Grab the cash, then lose the wanted level that follows: switch cars, break line of sight, and hide until the stars fade.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Find an armored truck on its route and force it to stop.
Crack it open and take the cash.
Escape and lose the wanted level.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). The map is divided into named areas, and each one counts once you have properly visited it — driving through on a highway may not be enough, so stop, get out and look around in each area. Work through the map region by region (Vice City, the beaches, the Everglades, the small towns, the countryside) and check the map for areas still greyed out or unvisited.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Work through the map region by region.
Stop and look around in each named area.
Keep going until all 52 areas are explored.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). Each gang runs its own operations — stash houses, labs, storefronts — and the trophy wants one hit against every gang, not nine hits against one. Learn which territory belongs to which gang, hit one operation per gang, and escape cleanly each time. The map and your contacts will point you at operation sites as you explore.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Learn which territory belongs to which gang.
Rob one illegal operation per gang.
Hit all 9 gangs to unlock the trophy.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a pure vibe trophy: head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. It is the kind of trophy that pops while you are doing something pleasant rather than grinding, so fold it into an evening of exploring the beachfront — find a venue with an ocean view, sit down, and order.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Head to Ocean Beach.
Find a bar or spot with an ocean view.
Order and enjoy a cocktail there.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a nod to the series' most famous openings. Drive into a showroom, pick a car, and crash straight out through the glass front. The trophy is about the exit, not the car, so any vehicle works: get inside, build a little speed, and aim for the windows. Expect a wanted level on the way out, so have a getaway in mind.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Drive into a vehicle showroom.
Pick a car and build speed inside.
Smash out through the glass front.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a round of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — finish the game. Bowling is a full minigame with its own aiming and power controls, so take a practice throw to learn the timing, then play the round out. You do not need a strike or a high score, just a completed game at this specific alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game and learn the throw timing.
Finish the full game to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — 'a partnership with mass appeal' — and the exact trigger is not pinned down by the description alone, so this guide will not invent one. What the wording points to is a partnership moment that draws a crowd: play through the story's partnership beats, keep an eye on public or crowd scenes involving you and your partner, and the trophy should come from one of those moments. If it has not popped by the end of the story, revisit the partnership missions and their public set pieces.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Play through the story's partnership beats.
Watch for public or crowd scenes with your partner.
The trophy comes from one of those partnership moments.

trophies.guide: The description — 'choices made (for better or worse)' — points to the game's decision moments, and PlayStation tracks a count of 500 toward it (verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026), so it is earned by making choices across the story rather than by one single decision. Take the dialogue and story choices as they come and do not rush past them; some choices may lock off other paths, which is why this guide flags it missable. If you want to see every outcome, keep a manual save before the big decisions so you can revisit them.
trophies.missable_reason: Story choices can lock off other paths: keep a manual save before the big decisions.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Make the story and dialogue choices as they come.
Keep a manual save before the big decisions.
The trophy tracks your choices across the story.

trophies.guide: The description is a wink — 'second time's the charm' — and it points to succeeding on a retry. In practice, this means failing something and then passing it on the second attempt, so it will very likely pop on its own the first time you retry a failed mission or activity and clear it. Do not force it: play normally, and when a retry comes, take the second attempt seriously.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Play missions and activities normally.
If one fails, retry it right away.
Clear it on the second attempt to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: The description — 'What the hell just happened?' — points to witnessing something strange or unexplained in Leonida, and the exact trigger is not pinned down by the description alone, so this guide will not invent a location for it. Strange encounters in this series tend to hide in remote places at odd hours: desert roads, swamps, hilltops at night, and out-of-the-way landmarks. Explore widely, visit odd spots, and the moment should find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Explore remote and odd places across Leonida.
Visit deserts, swamps and hilltops, especially at night.
Keep exploring until the strange moment happens.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Get a car or bike up to speed, pull alongside a pedestrian, and swing as you pass. It takes a little timing, so pick a straight, quiet road, line the pass up early, and swing just as you draw level. A bike gives you the clearest swing; a car works too if you time it right.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Get a bike or car up to speed on a straight road.
Pull alongside a pedestrian with a melee weapon ready.
Swing as you pass to bowl them over.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). Marked Bills come from robberies and heists and cannot be spent directly, so take them to a contact who cleans money and pay their cut. The counter tracks the total laundered, so keep feeding bills through your contacts after every big score until the $250,000 total is reached. It is a long grind, so start early and launder after every job.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Take them to a contact who launders money.
Keep laundering until $250,000 is cleaned.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). Every purchase counts — weapons, ammo, clothes, food, car mods — so this trophy climbs naturally as you gear up, but it is worth spending deliberately once you are rich: buy the expensive weapons, customise a car properly, and stock the wardrobe. Check your spending total in the stats screen if you want to see how close you are.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Buy weapons, ammo, clothes and car mods as you play.
Spend deliberately once money is plentiful.
Stop when $100,000 is spent across shops.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). Garages are properties you purchase that give you somewhere to store vehicles, and they are scattered across the map — city garages, beach garages, countryside ones. They cost money, so this is a late-game purchase: save up, then buy them one by one. The property screen or map will show which ones you still do not own.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Save up money through the story and robberies.
Find the 8 garage properties on the map.
Buy them all to unlock the trophy.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app (count verified on PSNProfiles 19 Nov 2026). The app lets you register vehicles you own or find, so the loop is: get a vehicle, open the Scooter Bros app, and register it. Ten different vehicles are needed, so use the variety you find while exploring — cars, bikes, anything the app accepts — and register each new one as soon as you get it.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (checked 19 Nov 2026)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (checked 19 Nov 2026)
steps: Get a vehicle you have not registered yet.
Open the Scooter Bros app and register it.
Register 10 different vehicles.
